_comment: This file is a configuration-only module (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines ImageNet dataset settings, preprocessing pipelines, and dataloader configs for MobileNetV3 pretraining in MMPretrain. No callable code exists for CLI invocation.
review_train_pipeline: review the ImageNet training pipeline config with RandomResizedCrop, AutoAugment, and RandomErasing augmentations
review_test_pipeline: review the ImageNet test pipeline config with ResizeEdge, CenterCrop, and PackInputs steps
review_data_preprocessor: review the data preprocessor config with RGB normalization mean and std parameters
review_train_dataloader: review the train dataloader config with batch size 128 and DefaultSampler shuffle settings
review_val_evaluator: review the validation evaluator config using Accuracy with topk 1 and 5 metrics
